fields.name: Luxe Marquee Package
fields.summary:
Premium milestone setup with marquee LED numbers, organic balloon arch, textured florals, and uplighting.

Marquee Light-Up Numbers: Large 4ft LED numbers that provide a warm, ambient glow.


Organic Balloon Arch: A multi-layered garland using a mix of chrome, matte, and pearl finishes in varied sizes for a high-end "organic" look.


Textured Florals: Dried pampas grass and dyed ruscus stems tucked into the balloons for added depth.


Professional Lighting: Ground-based uplights (PAR cans) to wash the walls in color and fairy light backdrops.


Personalized Touch: A bespoke neon sign or vinyl lettering on the wall/backdrop.

fields.name: Royal Crimson Gala
fields.summary:
Bold crimson and gold celebration styling with organic balloons, giant foil numbers, and confetti reveal.

Rich Color Palette: Deep burgundy/crimson paired with reflective chrome gold balloons.

Integrated Foliage: Gold-sprayed palm spears and dried fan leaves for a modern, edgy aesthetic.

Foil Balloon Accents: 18-inch circular foils with custom "Crown" or "Happy Birthday" vinyl prints.


Giant Foil Numbers: Iconic gold numbers as the central anchor.


Confetti Cannon: A coordinated gold confetti pop for the "big reveal" moment.

fields.name: Sweet 16 Pillar Setup
fields.summary:
Soft luxe Sweet 16 design with dual balloon pillars, helium canopy, and centerpiece foil numbers.

Dual Balloon Pillars: Two floor-to-ceiling balloon columns accented with fresh-looking silk flowers (peonies/roses).



Ceiling Fill: A cluster of helium-filled balloons floating with metallic curling ribbons to create a "canopy" effect.



Centerpiece Foils: Large 34-inch gold foil numbers positioned between the pillars.



Bunting/Backdrop: A high-quality "Sweet 16" cardstock banner or fabric drape.



Scattered Floor Balloons: A mix of air-filled balloons on the floor to tie the scene together.

Whether you’re surprising a friend, sibling, partner, or university student away from home, this package creates a memorable moment they’ll cherish long after the celebrations end.
